project_title: Full Stack Developer Needed – Billing Software (Flutter + NestJS)

project_metadata.job_title: Full Stack Developer Needed – Billing Software (Flutter + NestJS)
project_metadata.job_description:
I am looking for an experienced Full Stack Developer to build a modern, responsive, mobile-first Billing & Invoicing Software with support for multiple companies and Indian GST.

Tech Stack (Mandatory)
Flutter (Web, Android, iOS, Windows, macOS)
NestJS (TypeScript)
PostgreSQL
Prisma ORM
Redis
Docker & Docker Compose
Ubuntu VPS
Key Requirements
Multi-company & multi-user support
Indian GST (optional)
Multiple invoice templates
CSV/XLS/XLSX import & export
PDF invoice generation
Daily automatic backup & restore
Responsive and elegant UI/UX
Clean, scalable, well-documented code

A detailed feature specification is attached and must be followed.

AI Usage:

You may use AI tools (ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, etc.) responsibly to improve productivity. However, all code must be reviewed, understood, tested, secure, and production-ready. Do not submit unverified AI-generated code.

Deliverables:
Complete source code
Database schema & migrations
API documentation
Docker deployment
Setup guide
README
Deadline (Strict)

Project must be completed within 7 calendar days.

Please apply only if you have experience with Flutter, NestJS, PostgreSQL, and can confidently meet the deadline.

When applying, include:

Relevant portfolio/projects
GitHub (if available)
Estimated delivery timeline
